sourceTextExcerpts.text: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?
Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?

wikipediaRead.locator: 記事導入、本文行309（ファラオを古代エジプト王の称号と定義）
wikipediaRead.identityBasisJa: 導入はファラオを古代エジプト王の称号と定義する。これは1SAの用例に現れる特定の王を同定する根拠ではないため、称号への関連参照に限定。

occurrenceAudit.reasonJa: 個人名ではなくエジプト王の称号。
文脈上も称号の用法。同一の王との断定なし。

authorRepair.reasonJa: At knownBy 1SA2:27, summary explicitly says Pharaoh is used again in 6:6; the verse 6:6 is later and may concern another ruler.
authorRepair.changesJa: summaryから6:6への言及を外し、称号・個人名不詳の説明だけを保持。
